economy.summary: Says making life more affordable is a priority; supports tax relief for working families, lowering healthcare and prescription costs, expanding American energy production to reduce utility rates, and controlling government spending.
economy.short: Supports tax relief, expanded energy production, controlling government spending.

taxes.summary: Cites his support in his first year in Congress for increasing the standard tax deduction and eliminating taxes on Social Security for nearly 90% of seniors; opposes budgets that cut Social Security benefits.
taxes.short: Supports higher standard deduction, ending Social Security taxes; opposes benefit cuts.

abortion.summary: As a Pennsylvania state legislator he voted for a 20-week abortion ban (2016, 2017) and a 2022 proposed state constitutional amendment on abortion, and said in 2022 he has 'a solid pro-life voting record'; his campaign later removed abortion language from its website.
abortion.short: Cites pro-life voting record; voted for 20-week ban, amendment.

education.summary: Supports what he calls protecting parents' rights in schools; opposes what he describes as 'radical policies' in schools and opposes 'men in women's sports.'
education.short: Supports parents' rights; opposes 'radical policies,' 'men in women's sports.'

healthcare.summary: Supports legislation he says puts patients before profits by taking on insurance companies and middlemen; proposes measures to lower costs, improve price transparency, and expand access to care, and says he stands up for seniors on Medicare.
healthcare.short: Supports lowering costs, transparency; proposes taking on insurers, middlemen.

energy.summary: Supports expanding American energy production, which he says will reduce utility rates for families.
energy.short: Supports expanding American energy production to reduce utility rates.

guns.summary: Frames public safety around supporting law enforcement; says he has secured funding for law enforcement and first responders and supports cracking down on human trafficking and drug smuggling.
guns.short: Supports increased funding for law enforcement and first responders.

economy.summary: Proposes ending what he calls the affordability crisis; supports raising wages, price-gouging enforcement, and antitrust action, and proposes banning private equity companies from purchasing residential properties and raising the minimum wage with inflation indexing.
economy.short: Proposes ending affordability crisis; supports wage raises, antitrust action.

taxes.summary: Supports a billionaire minimum tax and proposes repealing the 2017 tax cuts, which he says could raise over $1.5 trillion; says corporations should pay their taxes.
taxes.short: Supports billionaire minimum tax; proposes repealing 2017 tax cuts.

abortion.summary: Supports codifying Roe v. Wade and proposes legislation to overturn federal abortion restrictions; opposes government involvement in personal healthcare decisions.
abortion.short: Supports codifying Roe; opposes government role in healthcare decisions.

education.summary: Proposes increased federal funding for public schools and opposes using federal money for private-school vouchers; opposes attacks on teachers' collective bargaining rights.
education.short: Proposes more public-school funding; opposes private-school vouchers.

healthcare.summary: Supports Medicare for All and proposes restoring Medicaid cuts; supports bringing down drug prices and expanding coverage to underserved areas.
healthcare.short: Supports Medicare for All; proposes restoring Medicaid, lowering drug prices.

energy.summary: Supports expanding renewable energy and nuclear power and proposes investing in union jobs in clean energy, while acknowledging capacity needs for natural gas power plants.
energy.short: Supports expanding renewables, nuclear; proposes union clean-energy jobs.

guns.summary: Says he supports the Second Amendment and proposes universal background checks, closing the gun show loophole, and enforcing waiting periods to keep firearms from dangerous individuals.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment; proposes universal background checks, waiting periods.
